verdict.rationale: Column documents its own card-program capability: it says it can support any type of card across major networks and issuer processors. A Column engineer adds that it is an issuing bank sponsoring Visa/Mastercard programs where partners can offer both physical and virtual cards. However, the evidence frames cards as a sponsored program run through issuer processors, not as cards issued directly through the same account API. Missing for 10: documented card-issuance API endpoints tied to accounts, spend controls, digital wallet (Apple/Google Pay) support, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
